minutes.headline: Select Board waived the town's right of first refusal on four lots at 100 Howard Street, voting unanimously.
minutes.summary: The Select Board honored a member with a Black Excellence on the Hill citation, heard from the Agricultural Commission and Water Commissioners, and approved a car show license. It waived the right of first refusal on 100 Howard Street, signed warrants, and pushed the turnover policy to April 23. No budget figures were set.

public_comment.topic: Complained about the board's January 9th discussion involving his family, an HOA law firm, and being denied library video clips.
Mr Bowen on Zoom raised cemetery reimbursement under chapter 114 section 15, care of 1700-1800 graves, and DPW costs.
Suggested free concerts at a music center for seniors, with transportation, and congratulated Mr Jeff.
Mr Bowen on prevailing wage and DPW union change to Local 170 Teamsters.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to waive the town's right of first refusal on four lots at 100 Howard Street.
A motion on a special event license for a car show fundraiser was made, but the result is not audible in the recording.
Approval of the draft turnover policy was pushed to April 23 for further review.
Ratification of three appointments was tabled to April 23 pending documentation.
Water commissioners said they plan a May 16 meeting to vote on appropriating state revolving fund money for PFAS remediation.

why_it_matters: Waiving the right of first refusal means the town will not buy the 100 Howard Street lots, so they stay in private hands and off the town's books.
A future PFAS remediation appropriation from state revolving fund money is a decision residents may be asked to vote on, and its cost to the water system is not yet set.
watch_next: April 23: the Select Board returns to the turnover policy, the tabled appointments and the farmers market with the Agricultural Commission.
May 16: the Water Commissioners' planned meeting to vote on appropriating state revolving fund money for PFAS remediation.
